sensitivity.method: metrics recomputed on odd vs even sample origins; top-5 overlap per ranking

summary.disclaimer: Road-network accessibility model for the bounded central Karachi study area. Not population-representative; not emergency-capability verified; no ambulance/flood/casualty claims.

sampling.method: Grid-stratified sampling: CORE bbox divided into 5x5 cells; per cell, drivable degree>=1 graph nodes with a baseline path to a mapped facility are shuffled with seed 20261010 and the first 4 are kept.
sampling.regression_note: The original six Phase 0/1 origins (data/origins_snapped.csv) are preserved separately and are NOT part of this sample.
sampling.interpretation_note: These are geographic sampling points on the road network, NOT population-weighted demand points and NOT actual patient locations.

candidates_method.method: Four deterministic tiers: (1) Phase 0 tested ways; (2) ways on the six original origins' baseline paths (<=4 km, capped 12); (3) top-50 ways by how many of the 100 sample origins' baseline shortest paths traverse them; (4) seeded stratified fill across highway class x latitude band (seed 20261010) up to 100 total.
biases: OSM completeness and mapper bias in central Karachi only.
Driving-road filter: service roads excluded from candidates.
A candidate is a full OSM way closure, not a single physical segment.
Origins are grid-uniform geographic points, not population demand.
Tier 3 favors ways on central corridors (path-frequency bias).
Ways longer than the length cap are excluded.
Rankings from these candidates are NOT a citywide criticality assessment.
